name: What Should an Agent Remember? (bounded-memory streaming-recall benchmark)

leads.arxiv: 2610.00366 (arXiv API: v1 2026-09-30; title: What Should an Agent Remember? Disentangling Retention from Retrieval in Bounded-Memory Evaluation)

community_list_entries.name: What Should an Agent Remember? Disentangling Retention from Retrieval in Bounded-Memory Evaluation

phase1_classification.kind_reason: The paper builds a synthetic streaming-recall benchmark: 300 seeded episodes of 10 'slot is value' facts plus queries, with a SQuAD variant. It crosses retention and selection rules under bounded memory. This is borderline because the main thrust is evaluation methodology.
